The Indian Coast Guard says it intercepted a merchant vessel carrying about 1,500 kg of heroin off the Gujarat coast, describing it as the largest single narcotics seizure to date. A joint investigation is underway involving the Coast Guard ship Samudra Pavak, the Intelligence Bureau, police, Customs, Navy, and other agencies. The seizure is being treated as a major anti-smuggling operation, with authorities now examining the vessel, crew, and route.[2]

The Lok Sabha has passed a new law aimed at preventing exam paper leaks and tightening penalties for malpractice. Officials say the measure is meant to strengthen the integrity of public examinations.[1]

At least 13 Indian seafarers remain stranded aboard MV Amir-1 after an attack near Chornomorsk port in Ukraine. India is monitoring the situation closely.[1]

Germany has reduced tourist visa appointment waiting times in New Delhi to just two days for Indian applicants. The faster processing is expected to make travel planning easier for tourists.[1]
